scope: isolated temporary Qt library workflows; no source edits or live native app changes

findings.finding: Filtering/search leaves stale inspector and mutation/assignment actions for an asset absent from cards.
findings.evidence: Images filter: grid_count=1, grid_current=null, inspected_kind=material, Use enabled. Nonmatching search: grid_count=0, same stale material/action.
findings.fix: Clear record, inspector/revision selection and actions when preserved selection is not in filtered cards.

findings.finding: No-op material editor roundtrip changes or discards existing supported/future metadata.

evidence.native_graph: valid .mtlx shader ref disappears because chooser only lists .blend
evidence.preview: RGB floats quantized to 8-bit, roughness .4567→.46, metallic .1234→.12

findings.fix: Preserve original objects/precision for untouched fields; retain unsupported combo choices; update only edited fields; parse deliberately edited structured values.

findings.finding: Partial batch-import error is overwritten by final success selection.
findings.evidence: Import valid PNG then missing PNG; visible status only Saved immutable revision <id>.
findings.fix: Retain aggregate outcome with committed successes/IDs and failed path after refreshing.

findings.finding: Synchronous unindexed scans and full thumbnail verification block Qt on every search change.
findings.fix: Cache/index immutable records, cache thumbnails, debounce search; move larger import/verification work off UI thread with selection-generation guards.

findings.finding: Native-graph-only material is labeled physical-only, and white preview colors produce white text on white.
findings.evidence: Code inspection of material preview branch.
findings.fix: Use independent engineering/appearance status labels and contrast-aware swatch text.

findings.finding: Lineage entries emphasize opaque IDs rather than donor labels; revisions, parents and dependencies share one flat list.
findings.evidence: Code inspection; details show dependency labels but history parent rows only role/ID.
findings.fix: Group revisions/derived-from/pinned-inputs, show donor label + revision, preserve navigation.

positive_results: Separate project-wide workspace and explicit type filters exist.
Geometry-only header controls hide in library workspace.
Images are first-class independently revised cards.
Native graph fidelity caveat is visible.
Provenance defaults license to unknown and external source opening is restricted to http/https.
Image reader rejects >40 million-pixel preview dimensions.
status: Findings sent to parent; ready to recheck after fixes
